breakNotes.Winter Break: January 4–5 are teacher and staff workdays with no school. Students return Wednesday, January 6.
breakNotes.Mid-Winter Break: February 8–10 are teacher and staff workdays; February 11–12 are student and staff holidays. Students return Tuesday, February 16, after Presidents Day.

comparisonTitle: Klein ISD Calendar Compared with Nearby Districts
comparisonSummary: Compare Klein ISD with Conroe ISD, Cypress-Fairbanks ISD, and Houston ISD for the first and last days and major school breaks in 2026–27.

comparisonInsights.label: First day
items: Klein ISD, Cypress-Fairbanks ISD, and Conroe ISD start August 12. Houston ISD starts August 10.

comparisonInsights.label: Spring Break
items: Klein ISD, Cypress-Fairbanks ISD, and Conroe ISD schedule Spring Break for March 15–19. Houston ISD schedules it for March 8–12.

comparisonInsights.label: Last day
items: Klein ISD and Houston ISD end May 28. Cypress-Fairbanks ISD and Conroe ISD end May 27.

comparisonFooterText: Dates are based on each district’s published 2026–27 calendar and compare equivalent break periods where available.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Klein ISD start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Klein ISD students start school Wednesday, August 12, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Klein ISD Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Klein ISD Spring Break runs Monday, March 15 through Friday, March 19, 2027. Students return Monday, March 22.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Klein ISD in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Friday, May 28, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When do Klein ISD students return after Winter Break?
calendarFaqs.a: Students return Wednesday, January 6, 2027. January 4–5 are teacher and staff workdays with no school for students.

calendarFaqs.q: Do Klein ISD students have school on teacher and staff workdays?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The teacher and staff workdays listed on this page are no-school days for students.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I find the Spanish Klein ISD calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The official Klein ISD 2026–27 Spanish calendar PDF is linked in the Downloads section.
